name: Honda C100 Super Cub
engine: 49 cc air-cooled overhead-valve single, three-speed with an automatic clutch
intro: The first Super Cub. No clutch lever, a pressed-steel frame and a step-through layout.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
